summary: Executed Phase61 backend + frontend validation on public preview URL, plus required Phase33 regression suites. Most requested flows passed; one backend enrichment gap and one testability issue found.

critical.issue: payment_method field is missing on at least pending fixture row (phase61-ui-pending). Requirement asks enriched response with payment_method.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate data-testid values detected on same page render: notification-bell-button and notification-bell-badge (count=2 each). Violates unique data-testid requirement.

action_items: Ensure /api/admin/payments always includes payment_method key for all rows (including pending/non-polled invoices), even when value is null/empty fallback.
Make notification bell/badge data-testid unique per rendered instance (desktop/mobile variants).
After fixes, rerun Phase61 targeted suite and repeat admin payments UI scenario from actionable baseline state.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin payment enrichment already strips Mongo _id correctly and provides action metadata/path for PPR/WAMI/custom/subscription.
Custom-service action guardrails are correct: only super_admin/admin_finance/admin_support allowed; non-custom or non-paid payments correctly rejected.
Idempotent paid-notification flow works in isolated test with MOCKED provider transport and MOCKED SMTP delivery; repeated reconciliation did not duplicate in-app/email delivery events.

success_rate.backend: 91.7% (11/12 passed; only payment_method enrichment assertion failed)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (core admin payment workflows passed; testability uniqueness issue found)

seed_data_creation: No new seed script run. Temporary backend test documents were created and cleaned up in test finally blocks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI run changed fixture phase61-ui-custom to completed via real admin action to verify actionable filter behavior. Actionable list now shows ppr only until fixture is reset. Initial state verification (dashboard actionable_payments=2) was captured before this action.
rca of the issue: RCA for backend failure: /api/admin/payments currently returns stored payment documents (projection excludes _id) and decorates them, but does not enforce a normalized payment_method key on every row. For phase61-ui-pending fixture, payment_method key is absent because provider reconciliation has not populated it yet and decorate() does not default this field. Mitigation: in payment admin enrichment layer, set payment_method fallback (e.g., null or 'Belum tersedia dari Xendit') for all responses.
